name: ai.carbackground/carbackground
title: Car Background AI
description: Replace car photo backgrounds, hide license plates and add dealer logos for vehicle listings.

tools.name: list_backgrounds
tools.description: List the background scenes available for car photos: built-in studios, showrooms and outdoor settings, plus the workspace's own custom backgrounds (`custom: true`, made with create_background or in the app). Call this first to pick a scene: each entry has a preview image, an example with a car, and the `id` that generate_background takes as `background_id` (custom ones also go to refine_background and delete_background). Read-only and free; takes no parameters and returns every scene in one response. For logos use list_logos instead.

tools.name: create_background
tools.description: Create a new reusable background scene for the workspace, such as the dealer's own showroom, a branded studio or a specific outdoor setting. Use it when none of the scenes in list_backgrounds fits; it does not edit a car photo (that is generate_background), and to adjust a custom background that already exists use refine_background instead of creating another. Give a `description`, `reference_image_urls`, or both; add `base_background_id` to start from a built-in scene and describe only what to change. Renders a preview with a demo car and returns it as an image plus the new background's `id`, ready to pass to generate_background. Costs one credit; a rejected or failed request is not charged.

description.description: The scene: walls, floor, lighting, setting. E.g. 'A bright showroom with light oak flooring and floor-to-ceiling windows'.

reference_image_urls.description: Up to three public image URLs of the place or style to recreate.

base_background_id.description: A built-in background `id` to start from; the description then says what to change.

tools.name: refine_background
tools.description: Adjust a custom background that already exists and render a new preview, e.g. after create_background when the preview is close but not right. `description` is only the change to make ('make the floor darker and the lighting warmer'); everything else in the scene is kept, and `reference_image_urls` can show the look to move towards. The background is updated in place under the same `id` and name, so later generate_background calls use the refined scene; photos already generated are not changed. Works on custom backgrounds only, not built-in ones; to start a different scene use create_background. Returns the new preview image. Costs one credit; a rejected or failed request is not charged.

tools.name: delete_background
tools.description: Permanently delete one of the workspace's custom backgrounds, e.g. a scene the user no longer wants in their list. It cannot be undone through this server; a deleted scene has to be made again with create_background. Photos already generated with it are not affected, and no credits are charged or refunded. Only custom backgrounds (`custom: true` in list_backgrounds) can be deleted, never built-in ones. To change a scene instead of removing it, use refine_background. Returns the `id` with `deleted: true`, or `not_found` for an unknown id.

tools.name: generate_background
tools.description: Replace the background of one car photo with a chosen scene: the main tool for turning a phone photo into a listing photo. The car is kept as photographed and gets shadows, lighting and reflections that match the scene. Works on exterior, interior and detail shots. Pick `background_id` with list_backgrounds first and use the same one for every photo of a car. In the same call it can hide the plate (`hide_license_plate`, with `license_plate_style` and, for `logo`, a `license_plate_logo` from list_logos), draw a dealer `logo`, reframe to an `aspect_ratio`, centre the car or show it washed. To hide the plate without changing the background use hide_license_plates; to make a new scene use create_background. One photo per call, up to 12 MB; the source photo is not modified. Costs one credit, and a failed generation is not charged. Can take up to a minute. Returns a signed `image_url` of the high-resolution result, valid for 7 days.

image_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the car photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP).

hide_license_plate.description: Hide a legible license plate (exterior photos).

license_plate_style.description: With hide_license_plate: `plain` (default) replaces it with a blank plate, `blur` blurs it, `logo` shows the dealer's plate logo (set license_plate_logo).

id.description: A plate logo `id` from list_logos with type `plate`.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Omit to keep the photo's own.

center_car.description: Experimental: centre, enlarge and level the car like a listing photo.

clean_car.description: Experimental: show the car freshly washed.

logo.description: Draw one of the workspace's logos on the result.

tools.name: hide_license_plates
tools.description: Hide the license plates in a car photo without changing anything else, for privacy before publishing a listing. Use this when the background should stay as it is; when the background is being replaced as well, set `hide_license_plate` on generate_background instead of calling both. `style` chooses a blur (default) or a solid `block`, and `block_color` sets the block's colour. Uses no credits: it is included with an active subscription, up to a fair-use monthly limit, and returns `subscription_required` for a workspace without one. The source photo is not modified; the result is returned as an image, with the areas that were hidden listed as `plates`.

image_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the car photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP).

style.description: Blur the plate (default) or cover it with a block.

block_color.description: Hex colour of the block, e.g. #FFFFFF. Default black.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Read the workspace's current credit balance, returned as `balance`. One credit is one photo from generate_background or one preview from create_background or refine_background; hide_license_plates uses none. Call it before a batch to check there are enough credits, or after an insufficient-credits error. Read-only and free; takes no parameters. It does not show plans or prices: when the balance is too low, use list_plans, then create_checkout (no subscription yet) or change_plan (existing subscription).

tools.name: list_logos
tools.description: List the logos stored for the workspace, to get the `id` that other tools need. `type` selects which set is returned: `logo` (default) for dealer logos drawn on finished photos, passed as `logo.id` to generate_background, or `plate` for designs shown on the license plate, passed as `license_plate_logo.id`. Each entry has `id`, `type`, `image_url` and `created_at`. Also call it before delete_logo, or before upload_logo to see whether the logo is already stored. Read-only and free. For background scenes use list_backgrounds instead.

type.description: `logo` (default): logos drawn on finished photos. `plate`: designs put on the license plate.

tools.name: upload_logo
tools.description: Store a logo for the workspace so it can be put on photos later. It does not change any photo by itself: pass the returned `id` to generate_background as `logo.id`, or as `license_plate_logo.id` for a `plate` logo. The file is fetched from `image_url` once and a copy is kept (PNG, WebP or JPEG up to 5 MB; a transparent background works best). `type` is `logo` (default) for dealer logos or `plate` for license plate designs, where `background` sets the plate colour behind a transparent logo. Up to seven per type: when full, remove one with delete_logo first. Check list_logos before uploading to avoid duplicates. Free. Returns the stored logo with its `id`.

image_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the logo.

type.description: `logo` (default): logos drawn on finished photos. `plate`: designs put on the license plate.

background.description: Plate logos only: hex colour behind a transparent logo. Default white.

tools.name: delete_logo
tools.description: Permanently delete one of the workspace's stored logos, e.g. an outdated logo or to free one of the seven slots before upload_logo. It cannot be undone through this server; the logo has to be uploaded again to restore it. Photos already generated keep the logo they were made with, and later generate_background calls can no longer use this `id`. Get the `id` from list_logos, and pass the same `type` the logo was listed under (`logo` by default, or `plate`). Free. Returns the `id` with `deleted: true`, or `not_found` when the id is unknown for that type.

type.description: `logo` (default): logos drawn on finished photos. `plate`: designs put on the license plate.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: List the subscription plans on offer, to quote prices or to get the `price_id` that create_checkout (workspace without a subscription) and change_plan (existing subscription) take. Each plan has its monthly photo allowance (`credits`), billing interval and price: `unit_amount` is in the smallest unit of `currency` (USD), and `currency_options` lists the fixed local prices whose keys create_checkout accepts as `currency`. Read-only and free; takes no parameters and is the same for every caller. It does not show the workspace's own balance: use get_credits for that.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Start a first subscription for a workspace that has none, e.g. when get_credits shows too few credits. Take `price_id` from list_plans; `currency` picks one of that plan's fixed local prices and `buyer` decides VAT handling for EU and UK buyers. This call charges nothing: it returns a Stripe checkout `url` for the user to open and pay, and the plan's photos are added once the payment completes. For a workspace that already subscribes it returns `already_subscribed`; use change_plan there instead. Needs an OAuth sign-in: with an API key it returns an error pointing to the app.

currency.description: A key of the plan's `currency_options` (e.g. `eur`) to pay the fixed local price. Omit for USD.

buyer.description: EU and UK buyers: `business` collects a VAT number (reverse charge), `personal` adds VAT.

tools.name: change_plan
tools.description: Change the plan of a workspace that already has a subscription, to a `price_id` from list_plans. Always call it first with `confirm: false`, which for an upgrade returns a preview of the prorated charge and charges nothing, and get the user's agreement to that amount. With `confirm: true` an upgrade charges the payment method on file immediately and adds the photos at once, while a smaller plan charges nothing now and is booked to start at the next renewal. For a workspace without a subscription it returns `no_active_subscription`; use create_checkout there instead. It cannot cancel a subscription; the user does that in the app. Needs an OAuth sign-in: with an API key it returns an error pointing to the app.

confirm.description: false previews an upgrade; true applies the change.
